<!--
  The head of an inner page with breadcrumbs. Axes: aside (none, figure: one large figure such as a count or a
  total, note: a small card with a glyph such as a delivery promise or a document version, facts: four key facts
  in two columns), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { PageExtras } from "./page-trail.types";
  import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";

  export type PageTrailProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    label: string;
    crumbs: NavLink[];
    extras: PageExtras;
    aside?: "none" | "figure" | "note" | "facts";
    level?: 1 | 2;
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import PageAside from "../components/page-aside.svelte";
  import PageCrumbs from "../components/page-crumbs.svelte";
  import SectionHeader from "../components/section-header.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    label,
    crumbs,
    extras,
    aside = "none",
    level = 1,
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: PageTrailProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={cn("py-8", (((tone as string) === "muted") ? "bg-muted" : ""))}
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  data-testid="section"
  data-tone={tone}
  data-aside={aside}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Container class={cn("mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4", "flex flex-col gap-6")} data-slot="container">
    <PageCrumbs label={label} crumbs={crumbs} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel} />
    <Box
      class={
        (aside as string) === "facts" ? "grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2"
        : "flex flex-col gap-6 md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between"
      }
    >
      <Stack gap="4" align="start" class="min-w-0">
        <SectionHeader titleId={titleId} title={title} heading={{ level, badge }} lead={lead} />
      </Stack>
      {#if ((aside as string) !== "none")}
        <PageAside extras={extras} mode={aside} />
      {/if}
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
